messages:
ana_support: FYI we got an upstream escalation from AcmeCorp. Their integration started failing after the model update to rwd-model-2.2.0-canary. They're seeing tool-call validation errors.

ana_support: Customer error snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  \"error\": \"tool_call_validation_failed\",
  \"message\": \"validation failed for tool 'shell.exec'\",
  \"details\": [
    {\"path\": \"args.command\", \"message\": \"required field missing\"}
  ],
  \"trace_id\": \"tr-0a9f2c3b\"
}
```

ana_support: They claim the same payload worked on rwd-model-2.1.0. Risk: production latency & some 4xx errors for them. Tagging infra/engine oncall.

miguel_engineer: Thanks — can you paste the exact request body they used? Also which endpoint (chat vs completions)?

ana_support: Chat completions endpoint. Example they sent:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  \"model\": \"rwd-model-2.2.0-canary\",
  \"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"run backup\"}],
  \"tools\": [{\"name\": \"shell.exec\", \"schema\": { /* omitted */ }}],
  \"tool_call\": {\"name\": \"shell.exec\", \"arguments\": {\"cmd\": \"/usr/bin/backup\"}}
}
```

miguel_engineer: Reproduced locally using the same body against the canary model. Getting same 400. Stack trace points to our function-caller validating against expected schema: it expects `arguments` to be a JSON-encoded string with field `command`, not an object with `cmd`.

miguel_engineer: Local validation log:
```
tool_call_validator: expected type=string for arguments but got object
expected field 'command' not found
```

eva_se: This looks like a schema change in the model->tool mapping logic between 2.1.0 and 2.2.0. Either the model now emits tool calls with a different argument shape or our decoder mapping was changed. Do we have diffs in the canary that touched function-calling serialization?

runtime-bot: Canary rollout metrics for rwd-model-2.2.0-canary:
- 00:00 -> 10% traffic
- tool_call_validation_failed rate: baseline 0.04% -> 1.9%
- top affected customers: AcmeCorp (5k calls/min), BetaFin

sophie_pm: Impact looks material for a few customers. If it's a serialization mismatch we should consider immediate rollback of the canary to avoid wider exposure. What's the proposed mitigation window?

miguel_engineer: Short term workaround: clients can send arguments as a JSON string with `command` key. Example payload change:
```
\"tool_call\": {\"name\": \"shell.exec\", \"arguments\": \"{\\\"command\\\":\\\"/usr/bin/backup\\\"}\"}
```
But that's breaking for many clients and not acceptable as a general fix.

ana_support: Customer asked for ETA. They have a nightly job affected.

liam_release: If we rollback, we need a quick approval. What do canary telemetry + error rate look like for last 30m? runtime-bot snapshot?

runtime-bot: 30m window: tool_call_validation_failed trend rising from 0.02% -> 1.9%. Affected reach: 12 customers, top two account for 70% of errors.

sophie_pm: Recommend rollback. We can't ship a model that changes tool-call payload semantics without a migration path.

miguel_engineer: Agreed. Also will open a patch PR to revert the decoder change and add regression test. ETA for patch: 2-3 hours. But rollback buys time.

liam_release: Rolling back rwd-model-2.2.0-canary -> rwd-model-2.1.0 on shared canary pool. I'll do a phased rollback and monitor.

liam_release: Starting rollback now. Will move canary traffic back to 2.1.0 and keep 2.2.0 out of auto-promote.

liam_release: `releasectl rollout cancel rwd-model-2.2.0-canary --target rwd-model-2.1.0 --force`

liam_release: rollback initiated :rocket:

miguel_engineer: Adding debug logs to capture the raw model output for any future analysys. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4812 (WIP)

liam_release: Rollback step 1 done. Reassigning 10% traffic back to 2.1.0.

runtime-bot: Traffic update: canary 2.2.0 -> 0% over 5m. Error rate for tool_call_validation_failed returning to baseline.

ana_support: Customer contacted: they confirm their jobs succeed again after we switched them to 2.1.0. They requested a postmortem and ETA for a non-breaking fix.

sophie_pm: We'll produce a short postmortem and schedule a compatibility test before next canary. Action items:
- miguel: patch + regression tests (2h)
- eng-qa: add tool-calling compatibility matrix in CI
- runtime: add canary alert for tool_call_validation_failed > 0.5% over 10m
- product: communicate to affected customers

eva_se: Noted. I'll help reproduce exact model outputs and capture examples. Please add them to the bug.

customer_acct_bot: Logged support ticket INC-4421 linked to this thread; customer notified of rollback.

liam_release: Closing rollback. Rolling back prevented wider regression. I'll keep 2.2.0 in a sandbox until patch is merged.

ana_support: Customer follow-up scheduled. Thanks team :heart:

miguel_engineer: Filed PR, added unit test for argument serialization. Next steps: dev review and merge, then new canary when tests pass.

sophie_pm: Thanks — postmortem draft due EOD.

ana_support: Thread resolved from our side. Marking as resolved in support tracker.
